description: Source code for the 'jsonreference' package implementing JSON Reference handling, including URL parsing, JSON pointer management, and reference inheritance.

classes.name: Ref
classes.description: Represents a JSON reference object with URL and JSON pointer components, and flags indicating reference type.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new JSON reference from a string, returning a Ref object and error.

methods.name: MustCreateRef
methods.description: Creates a new JSON reference from a string, panicking if invalid.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL component of the reference.

methods.name: GetPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer component of the reference.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the reference, preferring URL or fragment.

methods.name: IsRoot
methods.description: Determines if the reference is a root document.

methods.name: IsCanonical
methods.description: Checks if the reference is a canonical URL (http(s) or file scheme).

methods.name: Inherits
methods.description: Creates a new reference inheriting from a parent reference.
